name: nsd7/surge
description: Surge — a lightweight, self-hosted, Pusher-compatible realtime broadcasting server for Laravel. No required dependencies.

suggest.ext-redis: Enables the Redis scaling adapter for running Surge across multiple nodes.
suggest.ext-openswoole: Enables the high-performance multi-core Turbo runtime.
suggest.illuminate/support: Required only to use the Laravel integration (service provider and surge:serve command).
